image_query: Kangra painting Radha Krishna grove Gita Govinda Pahari school
tweets: Under monsoon skies, Kṛṣṇa waits for Rādhā in a grove rendered in the tender Kangra style — brushwork fine as a whisper, rain-clouds dark above peacocks and jasmine. The Pahari ateliers of Himachal perfected this lyricism under Kangra's hill court, c. 1780.
